name: Squee's mountain
description: The cave-system mountain where Squee's goblin clan lives and which is destroyed.

timeline.summary: After a week without deaths, Squee learns from Bulp that goblin Rarp was crushed by a boulder.
timeline.quote: Like most goblins at any given moment, Rarp was standing in the wrong place at the wrong time and was crushed.

timeline.summary: Rarp, still alive, leaks black oil from his eyes, revealing himself as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
timeline.quote: Rarp's eyes shot open, and Squee's stomach dropped as a thick black oil began leaking from them.

timeline.summary: Squee sends Bulp through a secret tunnel to warn a town that the Phyrexians are back and burns Rarp's body.
timeline.quote: "No, Bulp. You gotta tell them that the Phyrexians are back."

timeline.summary: Squee announces a celebration, planning to have the mana lamps turned off so torchlight will reveal gold-eyed sleeper agents.
timeline.quote: Squee hoped that a sudden influx of torchlight would allow him to see exactly how many gold-eyed sleeper agents he was dealing with.

timeline.summary: Spurna reveals herself as a sleeper agent, impales Squee and throws him off the platform, killing him.
timeline.quote: Spurna's arm had twisted and reformed into a heated metallic spike.

timeline.summary: Squee revives, sees the whole clan with gold-ringed eyes, and a rotting spell kills him again; the disguised Bulp is revealed to be Ertai.
timeline.quote: Ertai's spiked Phyrexian armor gleamed in the torchlight as the rot reached Squee's chest.

timeline.summary: Ertai explains how Sheoldred found him and says he wants Squee to beg for death, and reveals he took the Salvation Sphere.
timeline.quote: "Or maybe, I came here to make an unkillable goblin beg for death.

timeline.summary: Compleated goblins restrain Squee and sedate him on a table made of their fused bodies.
timeline.quote: One of the goblins had become a table, and Squee was shifted onto it.

timeline.summary: Squee awakens compleated, Ertai plans to deliver him to New Phyrexia for study, and Squee shows his new weapons.
timeline.quote: "You won't be a king in New Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Squee declares himself compleat; his arm blade severs the rope holding boulders, which crush him and set off a chain explosion of mana lamps that destroys the mountain.
timeline.quote: there was a smoldering crater of stone.

timeline.summary: In the afterlife, Salvation, taking Sisay's form, explains that it protected Squee's soul and offers him a choice of returning or passing on.
timeline.quote: Or you can walk through this threshold, and your soul will finally be returned to the aether.

timeline.summary: Squee chooses to return to life for one more chance, and Bulp, back from his errand, finds his king alive.
timeline.quote: "I wanna go back, Sally, but I only want one more.

timeline.summary: Squee and Bulp resolve to fight the Phyrexians together.
timeline.quote: "If Phyrexia's back, then it's up to smart goblins like us to kick their butts and settle the score."
